docs: Reviews content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of reviews, each with the rating as it is shown, the words, the portrait, the name and a line (the date, the product). One object is valid in every reviews layout (cards in two or three columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the reviews, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

rating.docs: the rating as it is shown (5 / 5)

avatar.docs: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

description.docs: a line: the date or the product; empty: none
